what: RSS of the Workspace Container's processes after two Codex turns (two idle app-servers) on step4a, `ps -eo rss,args` and `free -m`
decision: MAX_CLI_PROCESSES = 4 per Workspace (about 0.65 GB of CLI processes at rest); a fifth start is refused with the cap's reason
note: The 2-process cap refused a third Codex session in one Workspace (run failed: 'Provider session failed to open'), which is how this was found
